design.teacher: logistic on ORIGINAL A activations, C chosen on ORIGINAL validation
design.random_teacher: unit Gaussian direction per domain (seed 7000+seed), bias/scale from A logits

evaluation.data: validation only (GoT val, RepE validation, OWT validation); test never read
evaluation.independent_probes: fitted on ORIGINAL B activations: logistic (C chosen on original validation), mass-mean direction, MLP 768-64-1 x 5 seeds (scripts/geometry_of_truth/07 code)
evaluation.teacher_probe: reported separately as objective attainment only
evaluation.diagnostic: logistic re-fitted on RECONSTRUCTED B, scored on reconstructed validation (decodability only)
evaluation.behaviour: activation splicing (not steering): OWT delta CE/KL, GoT statement KL and cities truth preference, RepE final KL and persona-shift cosine
evaluation.repe: frozen logistic + mass-mean probes, direction fidelity (all-layer evaluation code)

success_criteria.primary: GEOGRAPHIC domain, for BOTH the B-logistic gap and the B-MLP gap (mean over 5 probe seeds): truth_aware gap < reconstruction_only gap AND < random_teacher gap on all 3 seeds, with mean paired difference > 2 x sd of the paired differences
success_criteria.secondary: same test for the NUMERICAL domain (reported, not required)
guards: OWT validation delta CE of truth_aware <= 1.10 x its paired base SAE
GoT cities truth-preference change of truth_aware >= reconstruction_only - 0.018 (2 pairs), mean over seeds
RepE validation mass-mean gap of truth_aware <= reconstruction_only + 0.02, mean over seeds
